body.x: Plantronics(www.plantronics.com) unveiled intelligent Bluetooth earphone at ‘Digital Experience!’ which ran Jan. 5 in Las Vegas. 'Digital Experience!' is an annual event only for media, held by Pepcom before the opening of CES. At the event, more than 1,500 journalists had a time to cover CES opening ceremony and startup products in advance.Plantronics’ Bluetooth earphone provides clear sound quality and comfortable wearing sense. It is an intelligent product, combined with various technologies like voice order and smart sensor, so that users can conveniently use it in everywhere and at any time.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' News page
